recognize_zh: 一顆嗜中性球的核分成約八個小圓葉，沿中心呈放射狀排成花冠或葡萄串狀，葉間以細染色質絲相連、中央留下淡染空隙，這就是葡萄狀核（botryoid nucleus），常與中暑、嚴重燒燙傷或古柯鹼/甲基安非他命使用有關。
features: Neutrophil-sized cell with a nucleus divided into multiple (about 7-8) small round lobes
Lobes arranged radially around a central pale zone in a rosette/grape-cluster pattern
Thin chromatin threads connecting the lobes toward the center
Dense, condensed chromatin within each lobe
Pale pink-lilac cytoplasm without obvious toxic granulation or vacuoles
Background red cells with mild crowding and a few platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a neutrophil with a markedly abnormal nucleus composed of multiple small round lobes arranged radially around a central pale area and connected by fine chromatin strands, producing a botryoid (grape-cluster) configuration. The cytoplasm lacks prominent toxic granulation or vacuolization. Background red cells and platelets show no specific abnormality. The findings are consistent with a botryoid neutrophil, which should prompt evaluation for hyperthermia, severe burns or stimulant (cocaine/methamphetamine) exposure.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic hypersegmentation shows six or more lobes arranged linearly along a chromatin strand, not a radial rosette, with macro-ovalocytes.
Apoptotic neutrophils show discrete round pyknotic fragments without connecting chromatin threads and have dense eosinophilic cytoplasm.

ddx.dx: Radial segmentation in Sezary or flower-like lymphoid cells
ddx.vs: Lymphoid flower cells have scant basophilic cytoplasm and lymphoid chromatin rather than neutrophilic cytoplasm.
